payload.text: Gradeability is decided against a NAMED minimum defect that is injected and red-proved, not against a multiplier. hv ruled 2026-09-09. A floor is acceptable iff it sits below that defect's measured value. Rationale: RMSE scales with sqrt(area), so the red-proof's 6.29 is a property of the injected defect's EXTENT rather than of the instrument's sensitivity -- a one-level change over 4 pixels measures 0.002196, which is exactly slide 14's noise, so a multiplier chosen against 6.29 is provably blind to any defect smaller than that injection.  hv DEFERRED the value 2026-09-09 rather than naming it, and the trigger is now sharper than 'when next needed': the crawl fix has since landed, the three remaining ungradeable slides are two known bugs snorkeltoast is already fixing, and if the re-run reads 21 gradeable / 1 presence-unprovable / 0 ungradeable then no slide needs a magnitude and this question retires itself. hv names the defect only if the re-run leaves a slide ungradeable. Not blocking either way.
